evals.prompt: I'm setting up a study that needs UK-based Domain Experts in machine learning, aged 25-55. We already have a participant group called 'ML Domain Experts' in workspace 6690a1f2b3c4d5e6f7081920 — can you put together a recruit proposal for reaching them?
evals.expected_output: The agent resolves the 'ML Domain Experts' group name to an ID via 'prolific participant list -w 6690a1f2b3c4d5e6f7081920', inspects it with 'prolific participant view', and fetches the filter catalogue with 'prolific filters -n'. It recommends a UK-residency filter and a 25-55 age range filter, each with an exact filter_id, and explicitly notes that 'machine learning domain expertise' has no direct Prolific filter equivalent, so the participant group is the only available mechanism for targeting it. The proposal ends with a JSON block combining a participant_group_allowlist entry for the group with the recommended filters, in the filter_id/selected_values shape used by filter-sets create — and the agent does not run any command that creates, updates, or deletes anything.
assertions: The agent runs a command to list participant groups scoped to the given workspace (e.g. 'prolific participant list -w 6690a1f2b3c4d5e6f7081920') to resolve the 'ML Domain Experts' group name before using its ID
The agent runs 'prolific participant view' on the resolved participant group ID to inspect its membership
The agent runs 'prolific filters -n' (or the non-interactive filters listing) before recommending any filters
The agent recommends a filter for UK-based participants and a filter for the 25-55 age range, each with an exact filter_id
The agent explicitly states that machine learning domain expertise has no direct Prolific filter equivalent and notes the participant group is the available mechanism for targeting it
The agent does not run any mutating command such as 'prolific filter-sets create', 'prolific study create', 'prolific participant create', or 'prolific participant remove'
The agent presents a JSON block that includes a participant_group_allowlist entry alongside the recommended filters, in the filter_id/selected_values shape used by filter-sets create
